newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTIKO RAISES 1997 OPERATING PROFIT FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: ESTIKO RAISES 1997 OPERATING PROFIT FORECAST.

text.p: Packaging and plastics company Estiko on Wednesday said it raised its forecast for 1997 operating profit to 15 million kroons from 13.6 million kroons.

"I am sure that our operating profit will increase. I think that this year it will be 15 million kroons, earlier we thought it would be the same as last year, in 1996 it was 13.6 million kroons," Kalju Hellenurm, Estiko Holdings chairman, told Reuters in an interview.
He said the company was expecting better sales from Lithuania and Sweden and that it planned to open a new production line for agricultural plastic wrapping.
The new line will be financed from a previously announced share issue, which takes place between April 24 to May 8.
Hellenurm said Estiko dominated the plastics market in Estonia and made 100 percent of the plastic bags for milk in Latvia and 90 percent in Estonia.
Some 45 percent of the firm's production is for export, of which 50 percent to Finland and Sweden and 50 percent to Latvia and Lithuania.
"Every year our production has been increasing by 35 to 40 percent and this will contonie," Hellenurm added.
